name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Magnetic Accelerator Rifle MAR-8 'Longbow'
description: A precision electromagnetic rifle that uses a 16-stage magnetic accelerator to launch a 2mm tungsten penetrator at velocities exceeding 3,000 m/s. The MAR-8 is Arcturus's answer to the increasing prevalence of heavy composite armor — at hypervelocity, the tungsten penetrator defeats virtually any personal armor system through sheer kinetic energy transfer. The rifle is semi-automatic with a 6-round magazine and requires a backpack-mounted supercapacitor for its power supply. The electromagnetic launch produces no chemical propellant signature, minimal muzzle flash, and a distinctive sharp crack from the hypersonic shockwave that makes the shot direction difficult to identify.
legality: Military restricted — active combat authorization only
specifications:
caliber: 2mm tungsten penetrator
muzzle velocity: 3,200 m/s
magazine: 6 rounds
effective range: 200-2,000 meters
power source: Backpack supercapacitor, 24 shots per charge
recharge between shots: 2 seconds
weight: 5.8 kg rifle, 4.5 kg power pack
penetration: Rated for all known personal armor systems
barrel: 16-stage magnetic accelerator, 80 cm
story_hooks: A corporate executive was killed by a 2mm penetrator that passed through their armored vehicle, their body armor, and the seat behind them — the shot came from over a kilometer away and only a MAR-8 has that capability at that range.
Arcturus is field-testing a MAR-8 variant with programmable penetrators that fragment after passing through armor — turning a precision weapon into an anti-personnel system.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, angular precision rifle with a distinctly futuristic geometry. The extended barrel dominates the profile, appearing almost disproportionately long relative to the receiver. The weapon has a predatory, stretched silhouette — less bulky than kinetic rifles, more elegant and purposeful. Clean lines and minimal ornamentation suggest military-grade engineering prioritizing function over aesthetics.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length: 142 cm | Barrel length: 80 cm | Width at receiver: 8 cm | Height with rail system: 12 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Balanced and surprisingly manageable despite its length — the 5.8 kg rifle distributes weight along the barrel, requiring the shooter to commit to stance but rewarding precision. The disconnected 4.5 kg backpack power supply shifts the platform's center of mass, creating an unusual but deliberate weight signature.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade titanium alloy frame with carbon fiber composite panels. The 16-stage magnetic accelerator barrel is hardened steel with electromagnetic coil jacketing.
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal gray with selective brushed titanium accents. The barrel shows subtle iridescent heat-stress discoloration from repeated electromagnetic discharge — deep blues and purples bleeding into the gray. All electronic interfaces are anodized black.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal gray primary with brushed silver/titanium accents. Accent colors: Deep iridescent blue/purple along the barrel, matte black on all electronic housings and rail systems.
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured polymer with embedded heat-dissipation channels. The grip is slightly larger than conventional rifle stocks to accommodate the recoil dynamics of electromagnetic discharge. Wrapped in synthetic fiber-weave for positive purchase even with wet gloves.
distinctive_features: Exposed magnetic coil spirals along the entire 80cm barrel, visible as recessed grooves with faint copper-colored contacts
Three capacitive targeting nodes mounted along the upper rail — small circular sensor pods with soft blue LED indicators (dormant: dark, armed: pale cyan glow)
Heat-dissipation vents in a geometric honeycomb pattern along the receiver sides
Charging port on the left side of the receiver (dedicated umbilical connection point for the backpack supercapacitor)
Rail-mounted power readout display — small LCD screen showing capacitor charge state and shot counter
Minimal sights: an integrated laser aiming module with redundant mechanical aperture sight (battle-loss backup)
Muzzle design: flared slightly, vented on all sides to reduce secondary shock effects. A faint corona of copper-tinted metal at the accelerator exit
Wear patterns: light scoring on the barrel from repeated electromagnetic discharge; the grip shows index-finger wear from precision shooting; cable routing shows battle-field improvisation marks
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: ARCTURUS DEFENSE SOLUTIONS logo embossed on the left side of the receiver (minimalist: a stylized angular 'A' with circuit-trace accents). Serial number laser-etched on the right rail. Military authorization stamp (faded red ink) on the underside of the charging port cover. Arcturus's corporate security sigil appears on the power pack connector.
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-worn but meticulously maintained. This is a Tier 5 weapon — owned by someone who understands its value and danger. Battle scars are present but localized: minor dents on the left side of the receiver (cover fire impact), faint carbon scoring around the muzzle, and abraded polymer on the grip from heavy use. The barrel shows the discoloration of repeated firing cycles. Despite wear, all electronic systems function perfectly — the capacitor pack shows disciplined maintenance protocols.
